16 open-source Ecovacs projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Ecovacs Deebot robot vacuums. 8 of 16 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: bumper, sucks, Deebot-4-Home-Assistant, ecovacs-deebot.js, deebot-client.
